subject: SLA: regional on-call split and crediting questions
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@nimbus.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Systems Procurement <procurement@nimbus.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: SLA pricing & regional on-call split questions

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the platform looks promising. Procurement asked me to follow up with a couple of specifics before we start legal:

- We need clarity on uptime tiers (99.9 / 99.95 / 99.99) and the exact credit calculation for breaches. Is credit pro-rated by incident severity or by weekly uptime windows?
- We operate in US and EU and would like to map on-call costs by region (so EU costs land on our EU budget). Can Redwood split the premium support surcharge per region/zone?
- Any standard onboarding/commit discounts you can extend for a 12-month reserved Dedicated pool?

Can you send a pricing matrix and a short mutual-action plan we can share with procurement? Also, please include any required evidence for SOC2 / audit timelines.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Cloud Operations, Nimbus Systems
procurement@nimbus.com

--
Nimbus Systems — www.nimbus.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@nimbus.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 12:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SLA pricing & regional on-call split questions

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. I can get you what procurement needs. In short:

- Uptime credits: we compute credits on a monthly window and scale by severity-level (sev1/2/3) with a capped maximum per incident. I will attach the precise formula (examples included).
- Regional on-call split: yes — we can allocate premium support charges to specific regions by tagging the Dedicated capacity and issuing segmented invoices. That will allow you to map EU spend to EU cost centers.
- Onboarding/commit discounts: we have standard tiers (5% / 10% / 15%) depending on committed spend and term; we can extend an early-commit 10% for a one-year reserved pool if we get signature within 30 days.

I'll loop in Ben (pricing) and Laura (legal ops) with the matrix and a draft mutual action plan. Expect a follow-up with attachments and a concise MOP.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@nimbus.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 08:30:00 -0500
Subject: SLA pricing matrix + on-call split options (DEAL-4829)

Sarah — attaching the detailed pricing matrix and the escalation SLA doc. Key highlights below:

Attachments: sla-pricing-matrix-v3.xlsx, redwood-escalation-sla.pdf

Summary options (all $ are monthly unless otherwise noted):

1) Base Hosted + Premium Support add-on
   - Uptime tiers: 99.9 (no credits), 99.95 (1% credit), 99.99 (3% credit) — monthly window.
   - Response times: Sev1: 15 min, Sev2: 1 hour, Sev3: 4 hours.
   - Premium support surcharge: +12% of consumption costs. Can be split by zone (US / EU).

2) Dedicated Reserved Pool (recommended for predictable throughput)
   - Dedicated SLA: 99.95 (base), upgrade path to 99.99 for an additional fixed fee.
   - Credits: computed per incident severity, pro-rated against committed monthly spend; capped at 30% of monthly fee.
   - On-call split: we tag nodes by region and produce segmented invoices (CSV export).

Discounts / Concessions available for Nimbus:
- 10% onboarding credit for the first 12 months if you sign a 12-month reserved pool within 30 days.
- Volume tiering: >$250k ARR → additional 5% discount.
- Legal redline allowance: we can accept up to two contract redline rounds before pricing is re-evaluated.

Open items we need from you:
- Confirmation of target monthly committed spend (ballpark number OK).
- SOC 2 evidence request list — we'll link the SOC2 report and evidence bundle in the MOP.

I included a sample credit calculation in the spreadsheet (row examples). If you want, we can run a mock invoice showing how credits would be applied for a hypothetical incident.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0123
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@nimbus.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA pricing matrix + on-call split options (DEAL-4829)

Ben / Diego — thanks for the quick turnaround and the spreadsheet. A couple clarifications before procurement will greenlight:

- The spreadsheet shows credits as a flat % for each tier. Can you confirm whether small repeated sev3 incidents could accumulate to exceed the cap (and how the cap is applied over the month)? We need to know whether cumulative small events could materially reduce our monthly invoice.
- For the regional split: does Redwood require separate Dedicated pools per region, or can one pool be logically segmented for billing? Which approach has lower cost overhead?
- For the 10% onboarding credit, is that applied to the monthly committed reservation fee or to overage/consumption?

Also can you share a DocuSign sample (one-pager SLA + order form) we can route to legal?

Appreciate it —
Sarah
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@nimbus.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 16:10:00 -0500
Subject: internal: approval request for Nimbus concessions (DEAL-4829)

Laura / Ben — looping you to confirm approvers for the concessions Sarah requested. Re-cap:

- Offer a 10% onboarding credit for year 1 applied to the reserved pool monthly fee (not to overage).
- Allow logical billing segmentation (no requirement for separate physical pools) and provide segmented invoices with a small tagging surcharge of 2% to cover billing overhead.
- Cap on credits remains as stated: capped at 30% of monthly fee per month; cumulative sev3 events are additive within the month but subject to the cap. We should provide an example invoice to procurement.

Request: Laura — can legal sign off on the 10% onboarding concession and the two-line order form (we'll keep standard indemnities; exclude SLA term changes beyond credit caps)? Ben — I will prepare the segmented invoice export sample and mock credit calc.

If approved I will send final MOP + DocuSign link to Sarah tomorrow.

Thanks,
Diego

Attachments: nimbus-mop-draft.docx (MOP draft), sla-pricing-matrix-v3.xlsx, redwood-escalation-sla.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4829, https://www.docusign.com/envelope/0A1B2C3D

3) Procurement: route DocuSign to legal for execution.

If you want a short 30-minute call to walk procurement through the credit calc and segmented invoice sample, Ben and I are available next week.
